meanings.en: a person who takes control of a country or people by force
meanings.exampleEn: William the Conqueror invaded England in 1066.
meanings.exampleTr: Fatih William 1066'da İngiltere'yi istila etti.

meanings.en: protected from loss, damage, or waste
meanings.exampleEn: The conserved wetlands provide a habitat for rare birds.
meanings.exampleTr: Korunmuş sulak alanlar nadir kuşlara yaşam alanı sağlıyor.

meanings.en: used to say that something is surprising or good in relation to a particular situation
meanings.exampleEn: She did very well, considering she had no formal training.
meanings.exampleTr: Hiç resmi eğitim almadığı göz önüne alındığında çok iyi yaptı.

meanings.en: to be made of or formed from particular things or people
meanings.exampleEn: The committee consists of ten members from different departments.
meanings.exampleTr: Komite farklı bölümlerden on üyeden oluşuyor.

meanings.en: to make something stronger or more certain
meanings.exampleEn: The company consolidated its position as the market leader.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket pazar lideri olarak konumunu pekiştirdi.

meanings.en: to combine several things into one more effective whole
meanings.exampleEn: They consolidated all their debts into a single loan.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün borçlarını tek bir kredide birleştirdiler.

meanings.en: one of the parts that a whole is made of
meanings.exampleEn: Hydrogen is a constituent of water.
meanings.exampleTr: Hidrojen, suyun bir bileşenidir.

meanings.en: a person who lives in an area represented by an elected politician
meanings.exampleEn: The MP promised to listen to her constituents.
meanings.exampleTr: Milletvekili seçmenlerini dinleyeceğine söz verdi.

meanings.en: involving quiet and serious thought for a period of time
meanings.exampleEn: He was in a contemplative mood, staring out at the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Denize bakarak düşünceli bir ruh halindeydi.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you have no respect for someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She looked contemptuously at the cheap gift.
meanings.exampleTr: Ucuz hediyeye küçümseyerek baktı.

meanings.en: in a happy and satisfied way
meanings.exampleEn: The cat purred contentedly on the warm windowsill.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi sıcak pencere kenarında hoşnutça mırıldandı.

meanings.en: relating to a large continent, especially mainland Europe
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel serves a continental breakfast of bread, cheese, and coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel ekmek, peynir ve kahveden oluşan kıtasal bir kahvaltı sunuyor.

meanings.en: a group of people with something in common, part of a larger group
meanings.exampleEn: A large contingent of fans travelled to the away match.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük bir taraftar grubu deplasman maçına gitti.

meanings.en: depending on something else in order to happen
meanings.exampleEn: The deal is contingent on shareholder approval.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşma hissedar onayına bağlıdır.

meanings.en: the fact of something continuing without stopping or changing
meanings.exampleEn: There must be continuity of care for the patients.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalar için bakımın sürekliliği sağlanmalıdır.

meanings.en: in a way that involves two facts or ideas that cannot both be true
meanings.exampleEn: The witnesses described the event contradictorily, confusing the jury.
meanings.exampleTr: Tanıklar olayı çelişkili biçimde anlatarak jüriyi şaşırttı.

meanings.en: a machine or device that looks strange, awkward, or complicated
meanings.exampleEn: He built a strange contraption for peeling potatoes.
meanings.exampleTr: Patates soymak için garip bir düzenek yaptı.

meanings.en: a feeling of great sadness and guilt for having done wrong
meanings.exampleEn: He showed genuine contrition for the pain he had caused.
meanings.exampleTr: Sebep olduğu acı için gerçek bir pişmanlık gösterdi.

meanings.en: a place or stage where something is checked or regulated
meanings.exampleEn: Every vehicle was inspected at the control point on the border.
meanings.exampleTr: Her araç sınırdaki kontrol noktasında denetlendi.

meanings.en: kept under control or managed; calm and not showing emotion
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a calm, controlled answer despite the provocation.
meanings.exampleTr: Kışkırtmaya rağmen sakin ve kontrollü bir cevap verdi.

meanings.en: a confusing and difficult problem or question
meanings.exampleEn: How to fund the project without raising taxes is a real conundrum.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi vergi artırmadan finanse etmek gerçek bir muamma.

meanings.en: to spend time getting well after an illness or operation
meanings.exampleEn: She went to the countryside to convalesce after her surgery.
meanings.exampleTr: Ameliyatından sonra iyileşmek için kırsala gitti.

meanings.en: to bring people together for a meeting, or to come together for one
meanings.exampleEn: The board will convene next week to discuss the merger.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetim kurulu birleşmeyi görüşmek için gelecek hafta toplanacak.

meanings.en: to move towards and meet at a particular point
meanings.exampleEn: The two roads converge just outside the town.
meanings.exampleTr: İki yol tam kasabanın dışında birleşiyor.

meanings.en: to decide officially in a court that someone is guilty of a crime
meanings.exampleEn: The jury convicted him of fraud.
meanings.exampleTr: Jüri onu dolandırıcılıktan suçlu buldu.

meanings.en: a person who has been found guilty and is in prison
meanings.exampleEn: The escaped convict was recaptured within a day.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaçan mahkûm bir gün içinde tekrar yakalandı.

meanings.en: a sudden uncontrolled shaking of the body caused by muscle contractions
meanings.exampleEn: The high fever brought on violent convulsions.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüksek ateş şiddetli kasılmalara yol açtı.

meanings.tr: açık havada yemek partisi, mangal partisi
meanings.en: a party where food is cooked and eaten outdoors
meanings.exampleEn: We're having a cook-out in the backyard this weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hafta sonu arka bahçede bir mangal partisi yapıyoruz.

meanings.en: the quality of being fairly cold in a pleasant way
meanings.exampleEn: We enjoyed the coolness of the shade under the trees.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağaçların altındaki gölgenin serinliğinin tadını çıkardık.

meanings.en: the quality of staying calm in a difficult situation
meanings.exampleEn: She handled the crisis with remarkable coolness.
meanings.exampleTr: Krizi dikkat çekici bir soğukkanlılıkla yönetti.

meanings.en: a machine that makes copies of documents
meanings.exampleEn: The copier is out of toner again.
meanings.exampleTr: Fotokopi makinesinin toneri yine bitmiş.

meanings.en: an informal short word for a helicopter
meanings.exampleEn: A traffic copter circled above the highway.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir trafik helikopteri otoyolun üstünde daireler çizdi.

meanings.en: relating to the physical body rather than the spirit or mind
meanings.exampleEn: Ghosts are said to have no corporeal form.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayaletlerin cismani bir bedeni olmadığı söylenir.

meanings.en: an official place where criminals are kept as punishment
meanings.exampleEn: He served three years in a state correctional facility.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir eyalet cezaevinde üç yıl yattı.

meanings.en: a pirate, especially one operating along the coasts of the Mediterranean
meanings.exampleEn: Barbary corsairs once raided ships across the Mediterranean.
meanings.exampleTr: Berberi korsanları bir zamanlar Akdeniz'deki gemilere baskın yapardı.

meanings.en: a slow procession of people, especially at a funeral
meanings.exampleEn: The funeral cortege moved slowly through the streets.
meanings.exampleTr: Cenaze alayı sokaklarda yavaşça ilerledi.

meanings.tr: kozmopolit, çok kültürlü, dünya vatandaşı gibi
meanings.en: containing or familiar with people and things from many different parts of the world
meanings.exampleEn: London is a truly cosmopolitan city.
meanings.exampleTr: Londra gerçekten kozmopolit bir şehir.

meanings.en: used as the past form of 'can' to talk about ability in the past
meanings.exampleEn: When I was young, I could run very fast.
meanings.exampleTr: Gençken çok hızlı koşabilirdim.

meanings.en: used to make a polite request or to show possibility
meanings.exampleEn: Could you help me with this box?
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kutuda bana yardım edebilir misin?

meanings.en: to have an equal but opposite effect that reduces or balances something
meanings.exampleEn: The tax cuts were counterbalanced by higher fuel prices.
meanings.exampleTr: Vergi indirimleri, daha yüksek yakıt fiyatlarıyla dengelendi.

meanings.en: a device that connects two things together, especially railway cars
meanings.exampleEn: The coupler joins the two railway carriages securely.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağlayıcı iki vagonu güvenli bir şekilde birbirine bağlar.

meanings.en: a piece of paper that gives you a discount or the right to buy something
meanings.exampleEn: I used a coupon to get ten percent off my groceries.
meanings.exampleTr: Market alışverişimde yüzde on indirim almak için bir kupon kullandım.

meanings.en: a document describing the main topics and structure of a course
meanings.exampleEn: The professor handed out the course outline on the first day.
meanings.exampleTr: Profesör ilk gün ders programını dağıttı.

meanings.en: polite and showing respect for other people
meanings.exampleEn: The staff were friendly and courteous to every guest.
meanings.exampleTr: Personel her misafire karşı güler yüzlü ve nazikti.

meanings.en: in a polite and respectful way
meanings.exampleEn: He greeted the visitors courteously at the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Ziyaretçileri kapıda nazikçe karşıladı.

meanings.en: an open area surrounded by walls or buildings
meanings.exampleEn: Children were playing in the courtyard of the old castle.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar eski kalenin avlusunda oynuyordu.

meanings.en: an attempt to hide the truth about a serious mistake or crime
meanings.exampleEn: Reporters exposed a massive government cover-up.
meanings.exampleTr: Muhabirler büyük bir hükümet örtbasını ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows a strong desire to have what belongs to someone else
meanings.exampleEn: He gazed covetously at his neighbour's new car.
meanings.exampleTr: Komşusunun yeni arabasına gıptayla baktı.

meanings.en: to bend down and move back because you are afraid
meanings.exampleEn: The dog cowered in the corner during the thunderstorm.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek fırtına sırasında köşede korkudan büzüldü.

meanings.en: a person who is skilled at making things, especially by hand
meanings.exampleEn: Each vase is made by a local craftsperson.
meanings.exampleTr: Her vazo yerel bir zanaatkâr tarafından yapılıyor.

meanings.en: not having enough space for the people or things inside
meanings.exampleEn: The four of us shared a small, cramped apartment.
meanings.exampleTr: Dördümüz küçük, sıkışık bir dairede kalıyorduk.
